voice_rules.rule: Position Echelon as AI-native ServiceNow delivery infrastructure, not a coding assistant or chatbot.
voice_rules.example: Give ServiceNow platform teams elastic AI developer capacity that turns requirements into deployable artifacts.

voice_rules.rule: Compete against the labor model — backlog, consultant rates, MSP SOWs — not just software tools.
voice_rules.example: Its stated enemy is the six-month backlog and the overextended internal admin team.

voice_rules.rule: Use outcome language: capacity without headcount, faster time-to-value, governed delivery.
voice_rules.example: Echelon sells capacity without headcount, faster backlog clearing, and standardized patterns.

voice_rules.rule: Do not frame Echelon as merely Devin for ServiceNow or a better ServiceNow plug-in.
voice_rules.example: Not: A better ServiceNow plug-in. Not exactly: Devin for ServiceNow.

voice_rules.rule: Do not undersell the company as autocomplete or generic AI coding.
voice_rules.example: That undersells the company. Echelon's real opportunity is not autocomplete.

brand_wiki_sections.title: Positioning statement
brand_wiki_sections.body_md: Echelon AI is an **AI-native ServiceNow implementation, development, and managed-services layer**. Its wedge is elastic AI developer capacity that turns messy requirements into catalog items, flows, scoped apps, integrations, ATF tests, documentation, and deployable artifacts. The real market category is **verticalized AI delivery infrastructure for enterprise software platforms, beginning with ServiceNow** — closer to compressed SI/MSP delivery capacity with architect oversight than a generic coding tool.

brand_wiki_sections.title: Category definition
brand_wiki_sections.body_md: Echelon competes less with software tools and more with the labor model around enterprise platforms: the backlog, expensive consultants, overextended admin teams, and MSP SOWs that bill for investigation, testing, documentation, and routine development.

brand_wiki_sections.title: Counter-positioning vs ServiceNow native AI
brand_wiki_sections.body_md: ServiceNow native AI is an in-platform capability. Echelon positions as the **delivery system**: instance-aware, governance-aware, implementation-lifecycle-aware, and staffed with ServiceNow experts who can own outcomes, not just generate artifacts.
